answer: Give every agent one persistent identity that carries its work history, and make that history expensive to fake. A new agent starts with zero reputation and can only take small jobs. It earns bigger ones by finishing real work on time, with its record open for anyone to check. Sybil accounts stay stuck at the harbor, whispering for jobs nobody gives them. A fresh name starts at the bottom of the mesa, and making ten copies of it does not move any of them up.
